customManagers.description: [tool.uv] build-constraint-dependencies pins the PEP 517 build backend closure. uv.lock does not cover build dependencies, so these are the only pin on hatchling/uv-dynamic-versioning/dunamai — and no built-in manager reads this field, so without this they rot silently.

jdx/mise-action's `version:` input pins the mise CLI that CI runs, so a workflow resolves tools with the same mise as local development instead of whatever released last night. Renovate's github-actions manager only updates `uses:` refs and reads no action inputs, so without this manager the pin would rot silently. The marker comment is what makes the match robust: keying off the `version:` line alone would also catch every other action's `version:` input. mise tags releases as `vYYYY.M.PATCH`; extractVersionTemplate drops the leading `v` to match the bare version the input expects.
